tagline: Unlocking the infinite potential of aluminum to advance a world free from waste
hero_kpi_rationale: The beverage packaging segment represents more than 95% of revenue, and its marginal evolution is the primary driver of operational performance post-aerospace divestiture.
company_description: Ball Corporation supplies aluminum packaging products for the beverage, personal care, and household products industries in the United States, Brazil, and internationally. The company manufactures and sells aluminum beverage containers to fillers of carbonated soft drinks, beer, energy drinks, and other beverages. It manufactures and sells extruded aluminum aerosol containers, recloseable aluminum bottles, aluminum cups, and aluminum slugs. The company was founded in 1880 and is headquartered in Westminster, Colorado.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total company sales after deduction of returns and discounts.
kpis.description: Revenue increased by 11.6% in 2025, driven by volume growth, price mix, and favorable currency translation.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by volume and pricing.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between sales and cost of goods sold, excluding depreciation.
kpis.description: Gross margin declined from 21% to 20% due to higher raw material costs, particularly aluminum.
kpis.signal: Margin compression linked to rising raw material costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Calculated from adjusted operating income and sales ($13,161M), operating margin remains resilient.
kpis.signal: Stable operating margin despite cost volatility.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on the acquisition or modernization of physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex amounts to $800M in 2025, slightly higher, aligned with expansion and optimization strategy.
kpis.signal: Capex increase to support capacity and efficiency.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Total headcount decreased to 17,500 in 2025 following the exit from the aerospace business.

kpis.name: Return on Invested Capital
kpis.explanation: Measure of the profitability of investments made by the company.
kpis.description: ROIC improved due to stronger cash flow generation and disciplined asset management.
kpis.signal: Improved capital efficiency through financial discipline.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $10.983B in the latest fiscal year (FY2017).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $1.273B in the latest fiscal year (FY2023).

kpis.name: Beverage Packaging EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin of combined beverage packaging segments.
kpis.description: Combined EBIT margin across the three beverage segments (NA 12%, EMEA 12%, SA 15%) improved from 12.5% to 13.5% in 2025, driven by volume growth and cost optimization.
kpis.signal: Improved operational performance across all three regions.

kpis.name: Volume Growth
kpis.explanation: Increase in volumes of aluminum packaging sold.
kpis.description: Volumes increased by 8.5% in 2025, driven by the shift toward aluminum in beverages and the acquisition of Florida Can Manufacturing.
kpis.signal: Strong demand momentum for aluminum cans.
